main_body: snow-covered roofed well with stone base and open water basin
top_band: snowy roof slope (white/light blue-grey) from row 1 to row 8, plus elliptical well rim and interior opening from row 16 to row 23
evidence: The well shows both a 3/4 pitched snow roof (rows 1-8) overhanging the wooden supports (rows 9-22) and a clear elliptical well opening (rows 17-22, 6 rows deep) surrounded by a stone/snow rim above a 7-row bricked front wall (rows 23-29).

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul roofed well reference, the candidate's stone base is a boxy, mechanical grid of flat bricks rather than organically shaded round stones, the wooden posts are thicker and less refined, and the bucket/rope lack the crisp detail and rich ramp of the reference.
